title: Ancient mural fragment with vivid colours uncovered at Erebuni
description: (Horizon Media / YEREVAN) — A joint French-Armenian archaeological mission has discovered a rare fragment of an ancient mural at the Erebuni archaeological site, with its colours remaining exceptionally well preserved after more than 2,500 years. title: Zendaya's ancient Iranian earrings stir debate over stolen artefacts
description: Experts said the Iranian 3,000-year-old gold disc medallions Zendaya wore at a promo event for Christopher Nolan's Odyssey were "likely looted". title: Ancient city emerges beneath Kilsadag Temple Complex
description: Archaeologists from the Institute of Archaeology and Anthropology of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences (ANAS) have completed the fifth consecutive season of excavations at the Kilsadag Temple Complex in Azerbaijan's Gabala district, AzerNEWS reports citing the Institute of Archaeology and Anthropology.
